name: hello-webapp

dependencies.name: hello-api
dependencies.description: Fetches the hello message shown on the greeting page.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs users in through SSO (PKCE) and signs them out.

description: Single-page React app that is the product's only user-facing surface: signs the user in through SSO, shows the hello message fetched from hello-api, offers a sign-out button, and shows a plain error message when the API cannot be reached. Serves static assets only; holds no data and no secrets.
